newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary revises 96 budg. deficit up to HUF178.7bln.
newsitem.headline: Hungary revises 96 budg. deficit up to HUF178.7bln.

text.p: The deficit of Hungary's central state budget was 178.7 billion forints in 1996, up from a preliminary figure of 130.5 billion forints, the government said in a statement on Thursday.
The figures exclude privatisation revenues and are both substantially below the 232.9 billion forint target for 1996.
The central state budget, including privatisation revenues, closed 1996 with a surplus of 77 billion forints, the statement said.
The final 1996 figures were included in the draft law on the closure of the 1996 budget, approved by the parliament on Thursday.
Government officials were unavailable on Thursday to comment on the changes in the figures.
